Home / Projects / Project Detail

Project Overview: Modern Commercial Complex in Thillai Nagar

A state-of-the-art commercial building project in Thillai Nagar featuring premium office spaces and retail outlets.

Engineering & Structural Challenges

Every construction project in Thillai Nagar, Trichy comes with unique site conditions. For this Modern Commercial Complex in Thillai Nagar, our primary challenge was the high water table near Makkal Mandram.

Sub-structure Solution:

Implemented specialized damp-proofing and a reinforced raft foundation using M25 grade concrete to prevent moisture seepage.

Structural Design:

Optimized the column placement to achieve a column-free layout in the main hall, using JSW Neosteel FE550D for maximum tensile strength.

Premium Materials Inventory

We used an "A-Grade" material list to ensure the structure lasts for generations:

Cement: UltraTech Super / Dalmia DSP
Steel: JSW Neosteel / TATA Tiscon
Electrical: Finolex Pipes / Havells Wiring
Plumbing: Ashirvad CPVC / Jaquar Fittings
